note: the bootloader chain, laid to rest. every file is <CID>/<filename> on any IPFS gateway.

balances.csv.desc: Complete liquid bank balances, every account, every denom

cyberlinks_indexed.csv.gz.desc: canonical cyberlink graph rebuilt from block events: 2,949,732 links, bit-exact to the on-chain counter

delegations.csv.desc: Every delegation: delegator, validator, shares, boot

holdings.jsonl.desc: Per-account breakdown: liquid, delegated, undelegating, per-pool (LP decomposed into underlying tokens)

passports.jsonl.desc: All 47,837 moon passports: nickname, owner, extension

pools.json.desc: All liquidity pools: reserves + prices at halt

prices.json.desc: Boot rate per denom from snapshot pool reserves + pool compositions

state_export.json.gz.desc: Full chain state at halt (all modules) — gzip

particles_availability.json.desc: availability audit over the full particle set: 3,069,134 / 3,143,648 (97.63%) present on the cybernode blockstore

missing_particles.txt.gz.desc: the 74,513 particle CIDs absent from the cybernode at audit time

ibc_escrow_boot.note: boot locked in ibc-go escrow accounts (bech32(sha256(ics20-1|0x00|transfer/channel-N)[:20])); the matching vouchers circulate on the counterparty chains

tocyb_to_cyb.note: at CYB genesis every TOCYB becomes 666 CYB (~1% of the Goldilocks field cap p=2^64-2^32+1); see https://cyber.page/cyber/$cyb/

supply_audit.method: sum over every non-boot denom with a warp quote except tocyb: supply(denom) x rate_in_boot(denom); pool coins and factory LP excluded (claims on reserves already counted in base supplies); rates from prices.json (direct boot pool first, hydrogen-routed otherwise, dust pools below 1e6 micro-units do not quote)

graph.method: full-history scan of 25,120,712 blocks for tx-blocks (5,857,263), then cyberlink events from block_results with self-computed tx hashes; counts match the on-chain graph_stats exactly
graph.note: the previously published indexer-based csv carried 15,241 duplicate rows and missed 259,630 links; this rebuild replaces it
